"How to do it in R" module (code panel)

Source: R/modules.R
kit_code_panel_ui.Rd

A collapsible block in the details row; the code is computed only when it is opened (Shiny does not render outputs inside a collapsed block), and rendered as one or more kit_code() (at most 70 columns per line, with "Copy").

Usage

kit_code_panel_ui(id, title = "用 R 怎麼做", open = FALSE)

kit_code_panel_server(
  id,
  code,
  note = KIT_CODE_NOTE,
  width = KIT_CODE_WIDTH,
  empty = KIT_CODE_EMPTY
)

Arguments

id

The module id.

title

The collapsible title.

open

Whether it starts open.

code

A function or reactive returning the code: a string, a kit_code(), or a named list of them (see snips in kit_code_blocks()).

note, width, empty

See kit_render_code_panel().

Value

kit_code_panel_ui(): <details class="kit-detail">, placed last in kit_details_row().

kit_code_panel_server(): a reactive with the current code (a list of kit_code(); NULL when there is none yet).

See also

kit_code_panel(), kit_render_code_panel() (low-level)

Examples

if (interactive()) {
  ui <- kit_page("KIT 示範", NULL, kit_details_row(kit_code_panel_ui("code")))
  server <- function(input, output, session) {
    kit_code_panel_server("code", function() list(tidy = "x <- 1", base = "x <- 1"))
  }
  shiny::shinyApp(ui, server)
}
